title: ocotea umbrosa var. bullata
intro: Ocotea umbrosa var. bullata, commonly known as the 'Bullate Ocotea', is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea umbrosa var. bullata include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, including limonene and eugenol, which contribute to its health-promoting properties.
